The decisive mistake was at step 6. By then step 5's output had shown that the sheet is organised in sections. A row in the Title column reads "DVD", and the titles listed beneath it belong to that section. The Platform column is mostly NaN and does not hold the format.

Data_Analysis_Expert ignored this and kept filtering on `Platform == 'Blu-Ray'`. That filter returned nothing, which caused the IndexError at step 7. Blu-Ray_Expert's later fix at step 8 dropped the NaN rows and then also found no Blu-Ray entries.
